name: Análisis de Profundidad de Cláusula
description: Mide the nesting depth of clauses dentro de sentences para detectar generado por IA text's tendency toward shallow embedding structures.
useCase: Detecting AI text through uniform and shallow subordinate clause patrones
mechanism: Parses sentences into clause hierarchies and mide embedding depth (main clause → subordinate clause → embedded clause). Computes maximum depth, mean depth, depth varianza, and depth distribución per sentence. generado por IA text typically shows lower maximum clause depth and less variation in depth a través de sentences, reflecting a flatter information packaging strategy compared to human writers who naturally vary entre simple and deeply embedded constructions.
source: Hunt, K. W. (1965) - Grammatical Structures Written at Three Grade Levels, NCTE Research Report
algorithm: Clause Boundary Detection + Depth Calculation + Statistical Distribution Analysis
parameters: Parser: dependency-based clause segmenter, Depth metrics: max/mean/varianza/distribución, Sentence min: 5 words, Text min: 10 sentences
strengths:
• Captures information packaging complexity
• Linguistically well-motivated característica
• Complementary to sentence-level metrics
• Effective on formal and academic writing
limitations:
• Parser-dependent precisión
• Some genres favor simple clause structures naturally
• Modern LLMs can produce complex embeddings
• Requires reliable clause boundary detección

references.title: Hunt, K. W. (1965). Grammatical Structures Written at Three Grade Levels. NCTE Research Report No. 3.
Gibson, E. (1998). Linguistic Complexity: Locality of Syntactic Dependencies. Cognition.
Tang, R. et al. (2023). The Science of Detecting LLMs-Generated Text. arXiv.
